evidence.title: Brand My Mac — Let your brand travel

name: Brand My Mac
summary: Live auction where brands bid for sticker ad spots on a laptop — lid, inside, charger and mouse — with the winner's logo riding along.
description: An auction site selling advertising surfaces on the author's MacBook Pro 14": 20 sticker spots across the lid (small 125 €, medium 200 €, large 400 €, premium around the logo), the palm rests, the charger and cable, and the Magic Mouse. The top bid per spot wins; each winner's logo becomes a die-cut vinyl sticker and a linked entry on the page, and the laptop travels to cafés, coworking spaces and build-in-public videos. 7 955 € was raised against a 3 644 € machine budget (goal passed at 315%).
contains: 20 sticker spots across lid, palm rests, charger and mouse
live bids per spot; 150 bids in total
top bids: 1 715 € above the logo, 1 300 € top left banner, 1 010 € top right banner
winners get die-cut vinyl stickers and a linked entry on the page
